about_the_game:
In the history of its existence, no one has ever returned from Axom alive. Armed with cutting-edge tech and unbreakable will, you intend to be the first to discover the secrets of the planet.

DEFEND AGAINST THE ENDLESS SWARMS

Axom: Conquest is a base building roguelite tower defense game set on the dangerous planet named Axom fighting against thousands of aliens who are very keen on you not being there!

Gather resources to build defences, unlock research between games to get stronger, discover insane upgrades and synergies and survive wave after wave of increasingly angrier aliens!

Features

  • Infinitely repayable procedurally generated levels - Each mission is different

  • Build your base - Construct towers, walls and hazards to defend your all important Nexus Drill from the hoards of Centurax trying to destroy it!

  • Wave based combat - Prepare and build in advance, then start the Nexus Drill, alerting all enemies in the area. Each wave the challenge grows stronger until you are ultimately defeated.

  • Gather resources - Gather from the ground, build refineries on resource nodes scattered around the map, but defend them well to keep your income stream safe!

  • Upgrades Upgrades Upgrades! - Discover hundreds of unique upgrades from bouncy walls to nuclear arms!

  • Every game you get stronger - Collect research while in game to complete research aboard your ship which provide permanent advantages for each subsequent game

  • Dozens of structures - Dozens of structures to build, including branching paths for different structure variants

  • Mouse only Support - Axom: Conquest is fully playable with only use of the mouse, with the keyboard providing shortcuts for certain actions

INFECTED GROUND

Battle against the planet itself as it comes to destroy you

BUILD YOUR PERFECT DEFENCE

Deploy dozens of towers and hundreds of upgrades

______________________________________________________________

Story

In the depths of space lies Axom, a planet overflowing with resources, a treasure trove for any daring enough to claim it. But you’re not the first to try.

You are an independent miner with your heart set on riches. 

Standing between you and those untold riches is the Centurax, a relentless alien force guarding their world with unending ferocity. Alone, you’ll face wave after wave, fighting for survival as you strip the planet of its bounty.

Yet as you dig deeper, the true purpose behind the Centurax’s defence begins to emerge, revealing a mystery buried in the planet’s core.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6GB) / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Base building, Tower Defence, and Roguelite progression collide in a war against hordes of endless alien foes. Find hundreds of unique upgrades and permanent unlocks and uncover the planet’s hidden mysteries buried deep within.
